H01 — The selected study reports a measurable improvement on its evaluation task

What the source reports
The study reports a measurable improvement in its reported metric on the study-defined evaluation task. [Evidence 2]
Limits: This is reviewed source attribution, not independent proof that the claim is true.

Petra’s bounded synthesis
Within this bounded packet, the reported result establishes a measurable improvement for the reported metric and study-defined evaluation task, but not for unreported populations, languages, model families, datasets, interventions, comparators, settings, or time boundaries. [Evidence 1, 2]
Limits: The packet is limited to the selected claim and recorded source path.

What remains unresolved
Whether the reported improvement generalizes beyond the study-defined evaluation task is unresolved. [Evidence 1, 2]
Limits: Relevant scope dimensions are unreported in the selected evidence.
To resolve it: New experiments evaluating the reported metric across explicitly specified populations, languages, model families, datasets, interventions, comparators, settings, and time boundaries would resolve this inference.

Evidence boundary
Every object in the bounded ContextPacket is accounted for; this is not a claim of literature completeness. Coverage: complete_for_context.
